output.reason: The release note alone is vague, but the linked PR [ev-5f600c2dbe2c] states the change: the package revision APIEstablisher now merges the desired ManagedResourceDefinition spec into the existing MRD instead of overwriting it. As a result, it never changes an MRD's state by accident and only sets it when explicitly making it Active, so state stays under external control. [ev-01b9844c8d60] confirms the change only touches internal/controller/pkg/revision/establisher.go. The section context shows MRDs were added in this same release [ev-47653e3e1ebb, ev-2c984df9c0e9, ev-76073e6d10e8], which makes this a fix to MRD handling for providers that ship MRDs, not a change to existing 1.x behaviour. Applicability and the exact earlier symptom (issue 6684, not shown) have to be inferred, so confidence is low.
